nodes.label: STELLA — a self-evolving multi-agent system for biomedical research whose capabilities grow autonomously through a dynam
nodes.result: STELLA — a self-evolving multi-agent system for biomedical research whose capabilities grow autonomously through a dynamically updated Template Library of successful reasoning workflows and an expanding Tool Ocean of bioinformatics tools discovered and integrated by a dedicated Tool Creation Agent.
nodes.paper: STELLA: Self-Evolving LLM Agent for Biomedical Research

nodes.label: State-of-the-art accuracy on biomedical question-answering benchmarks: ~26 % on Humanity's Last Exam: Biomedicine, ~54 %
nodes.result: State-of-the-art accuracy on biomedical question-answering benchmarks: ~26 % on Humanity's Last Exam: Biomedicine, ~54 % on LAB-Bench DBQA, and ~63 % on LAB-Bench LitQA, outperforming leading LLMs and specialized agents by up to 8 percentage points.
nodes.paper: STELLA: Self-Evolving LLM Agent for Biomedical Research

nodes.label: AutoScientists — a decentralized multi-agent system for long-running computational scientific experimentation in which a
nodes.result: AutoScientists — a decentralized multi-agent system for long-running computational scientific experimentation in which agents interpret a shared experimental state, self-organize dynamically into teams around promising hypotheses, filter proposals through peer critique before committing experimental compute, and propagate successes and failures across teams to reduce redundant exploration — without any central orchestrator or pre-specified search decomposition.
nodes.paper: AutoScientists: Self-Organizing Agent Teams for Long-Running Scientific Experimentation

nodes.label: Science Earth — a planet-scale scientific runtime in which any capability (simulation cluster, wet-lab robot, proof engi
nodes.result: Science Earth — a planet-scale scientific runtime in which any capability (simulation cluster, wet-lab robot, proof engine, single-cell pipeline) can connect to any other and collaboration structure emerges from the scientific question itself rather than from a central designer's foresight — shifts the organizing challenge in AI-native discovery from workflow design to open-ended connectivity.
nodes.paper: Science Earth: Towards A Planet-Scale Operating System for AI-Native Scientific Discovery

nodes.label: DN-Hypo-Pipeline — an LLM-driven workflow that identifies underlying laws, theories, and principles from a paper's expla
nodes.result: DN-Hypo-Pipeline — an LLM-driven workflow that identifies underlying laws, theories, and principles from a paper's explanandum and reconstructs novel, yet-to-be-verified scientific hypotheses from existing literature using scientific explanations as prior knowledge.
nodes.paper: DN-Hypo-Pipeline: An AI-Driven Workflow for Hypothesis Generation via Large Language Models and Scientific Explanations

nodes.label: LAB-Bench — a dataset of over 2,400 multiple-choice questions spanning literature recall and reasoning, figure and table
nodes.result: LAB-Bench — a dataset of over 2,400 multiple-choice questions spanning literature recall and reasoning, figure and table interpretation, biological database access, protocol troubleshooting, and DNA/protein sequence comprehension and manipulation — provides a benchmark for evaluating AI systems on practical biology research tasks rather than textbook-style science knowledge.
nodes.paper: LAB-Bench: Measuring Capabilities of Language Models for Biology Research

nodes.label: SWIF2T (Scientific WrIting Focused Feedback Tool) — a four-component system (planner, investigator, reviewer, controller
nodes.result: SWIF2T (Scientific WrIting Focused Feedback Tool) — a four-component system (planner, investigator, reviewer, controller) using multiple LLMs — generates specific, actionable, and coherent focused feedback that identifies weaknesses in scientific paper paragraphs and proposes revisions, outperforming GPT-4 and CoVe baselines in specificity, reading comprehension, and overall helpfulness.
nodes.paper: Automated Focused Feedback Generation for Scientific Writing Assistance

nodes.label: A controlled experimental framework for comparing human and LLM research idea generation — enforcing style standardizati
nodes.result: A controlled experimental framework for comparing human and LLM research idea generation — enforcing style standardization, matched topic distributions, and blind expert review — enables statistically rigorous head-to-head evaluation of ideation capabilities for the first time.
nodes.paper: Can LLMs Generate Novel Research Ideas? A Large-Scale Human Study with 100+ NLP Researchers

nodes.label: PaperQA2, a retrieval-augmented generation agent with agentic tool use (paper search, evidence gathering with LLM rerank
nodes.result: PaperQA2, a retrieval-augmented generation agent with agentic tool use (paper search, evidence gathering with LLM reranking and contextual summarization, citation traversal, and answer generation), matches or exceeds PhD-level subject matter expert performance on scientific literature retrieval and summarization tasks without restricting humans in time, tools, or internet access.
nodes.paper: Language agents achieve superhuman synthesis of scientific knowledge

nodes.label: LitQA2, a benchmark of 248 multiple-choice questions requiring full-literature retrieval to answer, where answers appear
nodes.result: LitQA2, a benchmark of 248 multiple-choice questions requiring full-literature retrieval to answer, where answers appear only in paper bodies (not abstracts) and ideally only once in all scientific literature, provides a rigorous evaluation of scientific question-answering that includes a direct human performance comparison.
nodes.paper: Language agents achieve superhuman synthesis of scientific knowledge

nodes.label: Popper — an agentic framework for automated, statistically rigorous validation of free-form natural-language hypotheses
nodes.result: Popper — an agentic framework for automated, statistically rigorous validation of free-form natural-language hypotheses using LLM agents that design and execute sequential falsification experiments.
nodes.paper: Automated Hypothesis Validation with Agentic Sequential Falsifications

nodes.label: CRISPR-GPT — a multi-agent LLM system combining chain-of-thought reasoning, retrieval-augmented generation, instruction
nodes.result: CRISPR-GPT — a multi-agent LLM system combining chain-of-thought reasoning, retrieval-augmented generation, instruction fine-tuning, and integrated bioinformatics tools — automates end-to-end CRISPR-based gene-editing experiment design and data analysis across four editing modalities (knockout, base editing, prime editing, CRISPRa/i) with tunable automation levels (Meta, Auto, and Q&A modes).
nodes.paper: CRISPR-GPT for agentic automation of gene-editing experiments

nodes.label: BioML-bench enables evaluation of AI agents on end-to-end biomedical ML tasks across four domains (protein engineering,
nodes.result: BioML-bench enables evaluation of AI agents on end-to-end biomedical ML tasks across four domains (protein engineering, single-cell omics, biomedical imaging, drug discovery), where agents must implement complete ML pipelines from task description to validated predictions.
nodes.paper: BioML-bench: Evaluation of AI Agents for End-to-End Biomedical ML

nodes.label: The AI Scientist-v2 — an end-to-end agentic system for automated scientific discovery that eliminates reliance on human-
nodes.result: The AI Scientist-v2 — an end-to-end agentic system for automated scientific discovery that eliminates reliance on human-authored code templates, uses a progressive agentic tree-search methodology managed by a dedicated experiment manager agent, and integrates VLM feedback for iterative figure refinement — can autonomously formulate hypotheses, design and execute experiments, analyze data, and author complete scientific manuscripts across diverse machine learning domains.
nodes.paper: The AI Scientist-v2: Workshop-Level Automated Scientific Discovery via Agentic Tree Search

nodes.label: Chain-of-Ideas (CoI) agent — an LLM-based research ideation system that organizes relevant literature into a chronologic
nodes.result: Chain-of-Ideas (CoI) agent — an LLM-based research ideation system that organizes relevant literature into a chronological chain structure mirroring the progressive development of a research domain, enabling LLMs to generate novel and logically coherent research ideas with experimental designs for approximately $0.50 per idea.
nodes.paper: Chain of Ideas: Revolutionizing Research Via Novel Idea Development with LLM Agents

nodes.label: GALILEO — Generalizable Agentic Laboratory Intelligence for Learning, Experimentation, and Optimization — is a physicall
nodes.result: GALILEO — Generalizable Agentic Laboratory Intelligence for Learning, Experimentation, and Optimization — is a physically embodied AI scientist that couples an Observation-Thought-Action-Summary (OTAS) reasoning loop with robotic peptide synthesis and multimodal phenotyping to close the prediction-to-intervention gap in therapeutic peptide discovery for dynamic membrane systems.
nodes.paper: GALILEO: Embodied AI scientist for autonomous therapeutic discovery in dynamic membrane systems
